findings.highlight: Even though we’re cooperating, stay away from Tohsaka
findings.evidenceJa: 仲間だからって、気安く遠坂には近寄るな
findings.governingReading: do not get overly familiar with Tohsaka just because we are allies
findings.explanation: Shirou limits Lancer’s familiarity; the English orders complete physical or social distance.

findings.evidenceJa: 虚を突かれたような顔
findings.governingReading: a face showing that he has been caught completely off guard
findings.explanation: A mental surprise is rendered as a slang physical assault.

findings.governingReading: that face as though you have seen right through me
findings.explanation: Rin’s embarrassment at being read correctly becomes irritation at presumed general knowledge.

findings.evidenceJa: 当の本人たちが誤魔化してる
findings.governingReading: the two people concerned are both dodging the truth
findings.explanation: mirror moon assigns the denial solely to Rin and erases Shirou’s participation.

findings.evidenceJa: こりゃこの先もタイヘンだぞ少年
findings.governingReading: you are going to have a hard road ahead of you, boy
findings.explanation: Lancer’s teasing forecast for Shirou becomes a flat judgment of the present situation.

findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂がタイヘンなのは、もう判ってる
findings.governingReading: I already know that dealing with Tohsaka is hard work
findings.explanation: Shirou’s rueful answer about their relationship becomes a direct insult to Rin’s character.

findings.highlight: I shall take care when I socialize with her
findings.evidenceJa: 気を遣って嬢ちゃんと付き合おう
findings.governingReading: I will be considerate in how I deal with the young lady
findings.explanation: Lancer’s promise of consideration becomes stiff and ambiguous English socializing.

findings.highlight: I’m breaking my ties with you guys
findings.evidenceJa: アンタたちなんてこっちから願い下げよ
findings.governingReading: I want nothing more to do with either of you
findings.explanation: Rin’s angry rejection is rewritten as severing established ties.
